result.reason: Static extraction from all supplied files only; no execution or additional reads. The implementation stores OAuth configuration locally, obtains and refreshes tokens, exchanges task/project data with TickTick, and prints results and diagnostics. Runtime behavior of Bun, commander, open, and remote services remains unverified because their implementations are not supplied.
